userSection.title: Most precise users
userSection.description: Registered users ranked by their percentage of correct answers on objective questions.
userSection.note: Only users with at least 3 completed tastings and 12 objective answers enter this ranking.

blind.description: Ranks wines by the real average rating they received in completed tastings.
blind.formula: The higher the average rating, the higher the wine appears.

qualityPrice.description: Combines perceived quality with the wine’s average price.
qualityPrice.formula: Rewards wines that earn strong ratings compared with their price.

surprising.description: Highlights wines that score well even when they are less easily recognized.
surprising.formula: A surprising wine has a strong rating and lower recognition in objective questions.

divisive.description: Shows wines that split the community’s opinions the most.
divisive.formula: The more spread out the ratings are, the more divisive the wine is.
